result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I would narrow the choices to **Gusto, BambooHR, and Rippling**\. The best one depends on whether you primarily need payroll, employee management, or a complete HR platform.

Here are my top recommendations for 2026.

## Best HR software for small companies

![Gusto Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ftD0qJ1yBSoWTtDEs2sOfDQ7-65e7zEzHy-HIAb3bqFrmNGGc0DyUX0E7CdY1ulVg_3Q5_8qLVi4LE1wqaQS_JVEpU9pxbwM6Kz6OYgPCcQM2vYw21WPy-MCNW4IYnmmdNSrLtuLoIyJLYtPy5hO5B7jEV7698TKyyKP6yzFWMR7Sgf2P81H8Y7V-Tx23IPn?purpose=fullsize)

(Best overall for small businesses)

**1\. Gusto**

Starting around \$49/month + \$6–\$7 per employee

- Payroll and tax filing
- Employee onboarding
- Benefits administration
- Time-off tracking
- Employee self-service

Best if you want payroll and basic HR in one easy-to-use system.

[Gusto website](https://gusto.com/)

---

![Free High-Quality Bamboohr Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NdLSBGjy-t4LAE90fgF-ddR4i37sUJnkP2I2etLyMCzK30ZNnDLeOFNkJ4ONgornqI4dpQO60O7vJzcBWlKGYP0PmgOwkcxyOEu4BL3JtyYZ8ZsdTCrW5IgVGOXAbKINwLVIP8GRxZkWvj639AwhCvO-Z0MW5ibDEnj4uSEouHdZBnZYXe0Ke7Brv94puUyT?purpose=fullsize)

(Best dedicated HR platform)

**2\. BambooHR**

Pricing varies; approximately \$10/employee/month in some plans

- Employee records and HR files
- Onboarding and offboarding
- PTO and leave management
- Performance reviews
- Recruiting and applicant tracking
- HR reporting

Best if you want a professional HR department-style system without building everything from scratch.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

Starting around \$8/employee/month plus a base fee; modules cost extra

- HR and payroll
- Benefits administration
- Employee onboarding
- IT and device management
- Workflow automation
- Time and attendance

Best if you expect to grow and want HR, payroll, and IT integrated.

[Rippling website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

Free tier available; paid plans start at low per-employee rates

- Employee database
- Leave management
- Attendance tracking
- Performance management
- HR workflows

Best for companies trying to keep software costs low. Payroll generally requires another Zoho product.

[Zoho People website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

![Homebase Reviews | Read Customer Service Reviews of joinhomebase.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ONPs31_XAP2XsJBs3Eie1qwgyuurZU2xtkB45n63IU2mOmCOoAYejKgqUNvwLJpQL-m8_ulLsnIwjUgfiI4WF5j-tZkBh8f6GZwUhD2ecILOo9YLaThDdn8foDqSv6GukdJX7e1Y6DGttWLJtIJKBrbS-cL872eVJQ2r8lUE_O-eo573PPEMZiZEhnAyfs0F?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Homebase**

Free basic plan available

- Employee scheduling
- Time clocks
- Attendance
- Timesheets
- Team communication

Best for restaurants, retail, and businesses with hourly employees.

[Homebase website](https://www.joinhomebase.com/)

Pricing and comparisons are based on 2026 published comparisons; actual quotes and add-on costs vary. ## My recommendation

| Your priority | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Payroll + HR together | Gusto |
| Full HR management | BambooHR |
| HR + IT + automation | Rippling |
| Lowest software cost | Zoho People |
| Hourly employee scheduling | Homebase |
